name: moire-interference-mesh
title: Moiré Interference Mesh
description: Two overlapping slightly rotated line gratings creating an optical moiré ripple pattern.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Passive Optical Illusion: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
